flood1936.method: geometric: building lies west of the Grant Street line, built <=1935, still standing. NOT confirmed frame by frame: archive photo sites (Pitt digital library, Heinz History Center, LoC, NARA) are blocked from this sandbox. Verify against actual 1936 frames before using on screen.
